title: Lighter, compact recommendation cards
summary: Refine You may also like with smaller image frames, white details and a clear product arrow.

changes.detail: Reduce card width to reveal more products; use rounded image frames with a white borderless text area, compact typography and a 44px product detail arrow.
Keep the brand in collaboration titles so names do not start with x. Render the crossed-out original price only for discounted products, removing the stray dash.
Remove the tinted lower panel, price divider and blank struck-through price placeholder.

validation.name: Code and visual checks
validation.detail: Pending code checks. Device visual review and gestures are unverified. Not deployed.
